diff --git a/README.md b/README.md
index 7505656..9234671 100644
--- a/README.md
+++ b/README.md
@@ -1 +1,21 @@
 # fixture repo
+
+## Running the tests
+
+Tests are run with [pytest](https://docs.pytest.org/):
+
+```sh
+pip install pytest
+pytest
+```
+
+Run a single file or test with:
+
+```sh
+pytest test_pricing_cache.py
+pytest test_pricing_cache.py::test_lookup_falls_back_to_snapshot
+```
+
+Note: this repo does not yet contain any test files, so `pytest` currently
+collects nothing. Add `test_*.py` files alongside the modules and the commands
+above will pick them up.
